Container.Name: ScreamingFrog-SEO-Spider
Container.Overview:
Screaming Frog SEO Spider (UNOFFICIAL) running in your browser via KasmVNC, with the native MCP server (v24+) exposed for Claude Code / Cursor / any MCP client, and optional Tailscale userspace egress so crawls exit through a fixed-IP exit node.
A PAID SCREAMING FROG LICENCE IS REQUIRED for crawls over 500 URLs and for MCP/headless features. This image does NOT bundle Screaming Frog: the official installer is downloaded from screamingfrog.co.uk on first start (SF_VERSION sets the minimum version). Enter your licence once in the GUI — it persists in appdata.
Memory allocation is set in the app (File > Settings > Memory Allocation) and persists in appdata.
MCP: enable it inside the app (Settings > MCP Server, base directory /config/mcp-workdir), then on your client: claude mcp add --transport http screaming-frog http://SERVER_IP:11435/mcp
Tailscale (optional, installed at runtime only if enabled): set TS_ENABLED=true and read the README first: https://github.com/pedrovillalobos/screamingfrog-docker#tailscale--fixed-ip-crawl-egress-optional IMPORTANT: do NOT use Unraid's built-in per-container Tailscale toggle with an Exit Node on this container — it routes ALL replies through the exit node and breaks LAN access to the GUI and MCP. The TS_ENABLED variables route only crawl traffic through the exit node.
Security: the GUI and MCP ports have no built-in authentication — keep them on your LAN/tailnet only, never expose them to the internet.
Container.Description:
Screaming Frog SEO Spider (UNOFFICIAL) in your browser via KasmVNC, with the native MCP server (v24+) exposed for Claude Code / Cursor / any MCP client, and optional Tailscale userspace egress so crawl traffic exits through a fixed-IP exit node while the GUI and MCP stay on your LAN.
A PAID Screaming Frog licence is required for crawls over 500 URLs and for MCP/headless features. This image does NOT bundle Screaming Frog: the official installer is downloaded from screamingfrog.co.uk on first start (SF_VERSION sets the minimum version; the in-app updater also works). Licence, configurations and crawls persist in appdata across restarts, re-creations and updates.
Full documentation: https://github.com/pedrovillalobos/screamingfrog-docker

Config.Name: WebUI (HTTPS)
Config.Description: Screaming Frog GUI in the browser. HTTPS with a self-signed certificate — accept the browser warning on first access. (The web client requires a secure context and refuses plain HTTP.)

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Licence, configs, crawls, exports and MCP working directory. Use a DIRECT path on your FASTEST pool, ideally NVMe (e.g. /mnt/nvme_pool/appdata/screamingfrog) — never /mnt/user/... The app is very sensitive to disk speed; on a slow disk it takes minutes to open and crawls run slower. Details: https://github.com/pedrovillalobos/screamingfrog-docker/blob/main/docs/STORAGE.md

Config.Name: Database directory (optional)
Config.Description: FALLBACK if you cannot put the whole Appdata on your fast disk: map your NVMe here, then in the app set File > Settings > Storage Mode > database location to /database (one-time). Details: https://github.com/pedrovillalobos/screamingfrog-docker/blob/main/docs/STORAGE.md

Config.Name: SF_VERSION
Config.Description: MINIMUM Screaming Frog version to install. Raise it and restart to force an update; the in-app updater also works and is never downgraded.

Config.Name: TS_ENABLED
Config.Description: Installs Tailscale at runtime (userspace) for fixed-IP crawl egress via an exit node. READ THE README BEFORE ENABLING: https://github.com/pedrovillalobos/screamingfrog-docker#tailscale--fixed-ip-crawl-egress-optional

Config.Name: TS_EXIT_NODE
Config.Description: Tailscale hostname/IP of the exit node used for crawl egress. See README.
